# Fabian Schuh

> Blockchain engineer (Dr.-Ing.) building peer-to-peer infrastructure on Solana — payments, arbitration, mutual risk pools. I believe people can do more together than apart, without surrendering control.

Fabian Schuh is a blockchain engineer and entrepreneur based near Erlangen, Germany. Founder and CEO of ChainSquad GmbH. PhD (Dr.-Ing.) in communications engineering from Friedrich-Alexander-Universität Erlangen-Nürnberg. Two decades of work across Bitcoin, Ethereum, EOSIO and Solana ecosystems, with deep roots in the BitShares, Steem and Graphene era of decentralized exchanges and social media.

## Why

I believe people can do more together than apart, without surrendering control — and build the machinery that makes direct cooperation work at scale. Every project removes a gatekeeper or gives peers direct capability: direct value transfer, direct dispute resolution, direct collective risk coverage.

## About

- Website: https://xeroc.org
- Location: Buckenhof/Erlangen, Germany

## Current Projects

- **Tributary** (https://tributary.so) — recurring payments protocol on Solana. One smart contract enabling subscription, milestone and pay-as-you-go models for unlimited businesses.
- **Accord** (https://useaccord.xyz) — Schelling-point arbitration oracle on Solana. Decentralized dispute resolution for subjective questions: randomly drawn, stake-weighted jurors, commit-reveal voting, exponential appeals. Integrates via a two-call CPI interface.
- **Riprap** (https://riprap.xyz) — permissionless mutuals on Solana. Peer-to-peer protection pools without an insurer; claims adjudicated by Accord jurors.
- **mash** (https://mash.fun) — prediction markets and sports betting, including leveraged futures via modified Drift.
- **Chaoscraft** (https://chaoscraft.dev) — collective creation experiment: 1,000 people pay $1 each to direct AI agents building into a shared codebase with automated spec, code generation, PR and deployment.
- **Polycode** — multi-agent software development automation (CrewAI) with GitHub App integration.
- **Allowly** (https://allowly.app) — pocket money for kids and AI agents.
- **ChainSquad GmbH** (https://chainsquad.com) — blockchain technology consultancy, 26+ projects delivered since 2016.
